# visionary_services (Data Source)

The services that reported to Visionary recently, for example to make one rule per service with for_each.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One error-rate rule per service that reports to Visionary.
data "visionary_services" "all" {}

resource "visionary_alert_rule" "errors" {
  for_each = toset(data.visionary_services.all.services)

  name      = "Errors in ${each.key}"
  metric    = "error_rate_5xx"
  op        = ">"
  threshold = 5
  scope     = { service = each.key }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always services.
- `services` (List of String) Service names.
